answer: The bias is baked into the silicon, so 141 aliases need 141 distinct devices, not 141 emulators. Sensor-bias calibration of the gyroscope forms a device fingerprint unique per chip. The beacon check is what stops the copy-paste farm: A fresh calibration reading is compared to the enrolled fingerprint each epoch. The violet record is public, the glacier cost is per identity, and 141 aliases cost 141 times one honest seat.
